title: Make Stop mean the same thing on both harnesses
description:
Claude Code keeps queued input through an interrupt and runs it afterwards, while Codex discards it. devhost's Stop treats both the same, so stopping Claude Code can start a queued message.

Use `interrupt` with `cancel_queued: true` when `interrupt_cancel_queued_v1` is advertised, and handle the `still_queued` receipt. Do not resend after that receipt, because a resend delivers the message twice. Define what the browser shows for cancelled messages on both harnesses.
